# Registers: V0=x, V1=y, V4=scratch key, V5=scratch, V6=scratch, V7=score, V9=BCD digit scratch

labels = {}

    rom.append((op >> 8) & 0xFF); rom.append(op & 0xFF)
def ref(hi, name):

w2(0x601E)      # V0 = 30   ship x
w2(0x610C)      # V1 = 12   ship y
w2(0x6200)      # V2 = 0    frame counter
w2(0x671E)      # V7 = 30   score

w2(0xA078); w2(0xD565)   # DRW V5,V6,5 at (0,0)

label('loop')
# erase ship at old position (XOR again)
ref(0xA0,'ship'); w2(0xD015)

w2(0x6406); w2(0xE49E); ref(0x10,'mv_right')   # 6 -> right
w2(0x6404); w2(0xE49E); ref(0x10,'mv_left')    # 4 -> left
w2(0x6402); w2(0xE49E); ref(0x10,'mv_up')      # 2 -> up
w2(0x6408); w2(0xE49E); ref(0x10,'mv_down')    # 8 -> down
w2(0x6405); w2(0xE49E); ref(0x10,'bcd')        # 5 -> BCD demo
w2(0x6407); w2(0xE49E); ref(0x10,'score')      # 7 -> score += 1

label('redraw')
ref(0xA0,'ship'); w2(0xD015)                   # draw ship at new position
w2(0x7201)                                     # V2 += 1 (frame counter)
w2(0x6302); w2(0xF315)                         # delay timer = 2  (throttle ~2 ticks)
w2(0xF21E)                                     # wait key -> V2  (pause until a key; keeps loop responsive)
# NOTE: F21E blocks; instead avoid blocking -> replace with nothing
rom[-4:-2] = []; fixups = [f for f in fixups if f[0] < len(rom)-1 or True]
# undo the F21E we just added (last 2 bytes)
rom.pop(); rom.pop()
ref(0x12,'loop')                               # JP loop

label('mv_right'); w2(0x7004); ref(0x12,'redraw')   # x += 4

# fix last emitted: replace 6005 8007 with 70FC

ref(0x12,'redraw')
label('mv_up');    w2(0x6104); w2(0x8105)
# fix: 71FC -> y -= 4
rom[-4] = 0x71; rom[-3] = 0xFC
ref(0x12,'redraw')
label('mv_down');  w2(0x7104); ref(0x12,'redraw')    # y += 4

# ---------- SCORE (key 7): V7 += 1, draw digit at (10,0) ----------
label('score')
w2(0x7701)                                     # V7 += 1
w2(0x650A); w2(0x6600)                         # V5=10, V6=0  (erase spot)
w2(0x00E1)  # invalid; remove
rom.pop(); rom.pop()

rom.pop(); rom.pop()

w2(0x8994); w2(0x8994)   # V9 = V9 << 2  (V9*4)
w2(0x8955)      # V9 = V9 + V5  (V9*5)
w2(0xF91E)      # I += V9
w2(0x650A); w2(0x6600)   # x=10,y=0
w2(0xD565)      # draw digit
ref(0x12,'redraw')

# ---------- BCD (key 5): V7 -> BCD at I, draw 3 digits ----------
label('bcd')
w2(0xA300)      # I = 0x300 (scratch area)
w2(0xF733)      # BCD V7 -> mem[I..I+2]
# draw hundreds at (20,0)
w2(0xA300); w2(0xA300)
rom.pop(); rom.pop(); rom.pop()
w2(0xF565)  # invalid reg count; use 8-reg load from I: F565 loads V0..V5? -> 8 regs: F865 loads V0..V7
rom.pop(); rom.pop()
# Load V0..V2 from 0x300: but V0/V1 are x/y! Preserve them.
w2(0x6A00); w2(0xFA0A)  # invalid
rom.pop(); rom.pop(); rom.pop()
# Save x,y first
w2(0x6500); w2(0xF555)  # invalid (Fx55 uses I)
rom.pop(); rom.pop(); rom.pop()
print("design pass done, len:", len(rom))
